missed_mechanisms.name: DR-EST-1 PreConverge establish probe — token-EXEMPT pacer bypass (default ON in product)
missed_mechanisms.evidence: crates/adaptive-transport/src/sender.rs:1533-1536 `establish_probe_enabled: bool` doc `[DR-EST-1] Kuruluş-kolu anahtarı (DEFAULT-ON — ürün-davranışı)`; :1819 `establish_probe_enabled: true,` in new_internal; :4070 `self.drain_establish_probe(&mut out, now_ns);` called at the end of schedule_transmit on the shipping path; :5541 doc `Tek-slot, backoff'lu, token-muaf`; :5542-5589 body emits a Duplicate via `self.track_sent(dup.unit, now_ns, 0, TransmitKind::Duplicate)` with NO try_send_pre_parity / pacer.try_send call. grep -rn set_establish_probe crates → only sender.rs:5598 (the setter) plus tests; ZERO product callers, so the product cannot turn it off. This is a bandwidth/pacing-cluster mechanism twice over: (a) it is the only default-ON emission path that bypasses the token bucket, directly contradicting specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md L333 `Kopyalar da AYNI pacer'dan geçer (§13); pacer'ı baypas eden gönderim yolu YOK (DATA/retransmit/kopya tek token bucket'ı paylaşır)`; (b) it feeds the delivery-rate sampler (track_sent → bw_sampler.on_sent at 5767) and, because it consumes from dup_queue, it participates in the more_pending / app_limited computation at 5758. It is also the only pacing-cluster mechanism with product telemetry (runtime.rs:1412 establish_probes_tx; KP-CLIENT `establish_tx=`). Backoff constants: ESTABLISH_PROBE_INITIAL_NS=500ms (sender.rs:1389), ESTABLISH_PROBE_CAP_NS=8s (:1390).
missed_mechanisms.suggested_classification: SHIP with a BLOCKING spec conflict (pacer-bypass forbidden by §3.3-B L333) — same class of unrecorded deviation as the Initial Window record, and it should be adjudicated alongside it

missed_mechanisms.name: DRAIN_RTPROP — RTprop refresh probe (§8.3), fully wired in product
missed_mechanisms.evidence: Not listed as a mechanism anywhere in the findings, yet it is a first-class §8.3 pacing phase and it IS on the product path. crates/client-core/src/runtime.rs:62 `const RTPROP_TICK: Duration = Duration::from_millis(200);`; :908 `let mut rtprop = interval(RTPROP_TICK);`; :1328-1344 `_ = rtprop.tick() => { ... drive!(Event::TimerFired(Timer::RtpropProbe), now); }`. Engine: sender.rs:3093-3108 `Timer::RtpropProbe => { if self.state == SenderState::Steady { let stale = self.rtt.rtprop_age_ns(now_ns).is_some_and(|age| age >= self.rtt.rtprop_window_ns() / 2); if stale { self.state = SenderState::DrainRtprop; ... } } }`; exit invariant at :3823-3841 `(elapsed >= min_dwell && self.drain_rtprop_qualifying) || elapsed >= max_dwell` with DRAIN_RTPROP_MIN/MAX_DWELL_EPOCH = 1/3 (sender.rs:1421-1422); qualifying set at :3064-3065; gain at :4013 `SenderState::DrainRtprop => PacingPhase::ProbeDown`. Spec authority: specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md L639-641 (DRAIN_RTPROP block) and §16.2 `DrainRtprop dwell` row marked FIXED [TUR-3b]. Pinned by sender.rs:8167 drain_rtprop_contract_dwell_and_exit_invariant.

missed_mechanisms.name: Pacer liveness path: TokenBucket::ns_until_sendable → Sender::pending_work_ready_ns → Sender::next_wakeup_ns (EK4-A2) — zero product consumers
missed_mechanisms.evidence: crates/adaptive-transport/src/pacer.rs:112 `pub fn ns_until_sendable(&self, size: u64) -> Option<u64>`; consumed at sender.rs:2490 and :2563 (`let dt = self.pacer.ns_until_sendable(smallest)?;`) which feed sender.rs:2433-2435 `pub fn next_wakeup_ns(&self) -> Option<u64> { Self::earlier(self.next_timer_deadline_ns(), self.pending_work_ready_ns()) }`. Product consumers: NONE. grep -rn next_wakeup_ns crates/client-core crates/bench crates/kama-engine → only crates/client-core/src/runtime.rs:6 and :61, both comments, and both explicitly declining it: line 6 `next_wakeup_ns()'e tek-kaynak-uyku YOK (D3, EK4-A2 tarihi): pompa idempotent + kanıtlı.`, line 61 `RTprop probe periyodu (§8.3) — next_wakeup_ns kaynağı DEĞİL, kaba tick şart.` The only non-test caller in the whole tree is crates/adaptive-transport/src/udp_runner.rs:862, and udp_runner is compiled only under `#[cfg(feature = "experimental-fec-budget")]` (lib.rs:56-57), a feature bench never enables (crates/bench/Cargo.toml [features] lists only diag-sched-telemetry). The shipping liveness source is instead the unconditional 1 ms PACE_TICK pump (runtime.rs:60, 1326).
missed_mechanisms.suggested_classification: KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL (correctly default-unused; the 1 ms pump is the shipping mechanism) — but it must be recorded, because the C2 post-condition at sender.rs:2337 is described as NORMATİF and nothing in the product observes it

missed_mechanisms.name: Dead carrier fields on the delivery-rate sample: SentPacket.gain_ge1 / RateSample.gain_ge1, RateSample.ack_elapsed, RateSample.sent_ns
missed_mechanisms.evidence: All three are computed and propagated on every single product emission and every ACK, and never read. gain_ge1: written at sender.rs:5763-5769 (`let gain_ge1 = !matches!(self.state, Drain | DrainRtprop | PreConverge);`), stored bw.rs:31/78-88, copied into RateSample bw.rs:112. Repo-wide grep for `gain_ge1` outside bw.rs returns ONLY sender.rs:5763/5769 (the writes) and tv_bw.rs struct-literal initializers — zero reads. The code says so itself at sender.rs:5762: `(örnek-sınıflandırma-bilgisi; tüketicisi-arşivlendi, alan-korunur)`. Same for `ack_elapsed` (bw.rs:45-46, TUR-D1 P1) and `sent_ns` (bw.rs:48-49, TUR-D1 F2): grep `\.ack_elapsed` / `sample.sent_ns` across crates returns no reader outside bw.rs. Their intended consumers (K_FRESH taze-snapshot kapısı, K_SHRINK) are marked **ARŞİV — MUST NOT IMPLEMENT** in specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md §16.1.
missed_mechanisms.suggested_classification: DELETE (spec explicitly forbids implementing the consumers; retaining written-never-read fields on the hot path is exactly the 'misleading' case in the rubric) — or, if retained, they need an explicit MUST-NOT-IMPLEMENT marker at the field, not a parenthetical

missed_mechanisms.name: §8.5 upper budget clamp: budget::budget_cap_permille + budget::parity_final + BudgetConfig.budget_ref_bps / profile_cap_permille
missed_mechanisms.evidence: crates/adaptive-transport/src/budget.rs:38 `pub fn budget_cap_permille(btlbw: u64, cfg: &BudgetConfig) -> u32` and :45 `pub fn parity_final(...)`. Repo-wide grep: the ONLY callers are crates/adaptive-transport/tests/tv_emergency.rs:21-39. Zero callers in sender.rs, client-core, kama-engine or bench. The two config fields that feed them (budget.rs:14 profile_cap_permille=900, :20 budget_ref_bps=125_000) are initialized at sender.rs:1781 and never read (grep budget_cfg in sender.rs → only :4032 reading min_rate_bps). This is the BtlBw-derived half of the §8.5 clamp — specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md L663-666 `available_redundancy_budget = f(BtlBw, mevcut tx ihtiyacı)` / `parity_final = min(fuzzy_parity, budget_cap, profile_cap)`. The findings mention it only as a cross-reference in the MIN_RATE record's notes ('see parity budget clamp record'); no such record exists in this cluster, and the mechanism is bandwidth-derived, so it belongs here at least as a boundary item.
missed_mechanisms.suggested_classification: WIRE (spec-normative §8.5, BtlBw-derived, zero product call sites) — confirm ownership with the FEC cluster so it is not dropped between the two

missed_mechanisms.name: Duplicated static return-BW prior: 65/31 (computed) vs 2_097_000_000 ns (hardcoded literal)
missed_mechanisms.evidence: The same declared static prior is encoded twice, independently. expected_ack_interval computes it at sender.rs:3271 as `EAI_SACK_WIRE_BYTES * 1_000_000_000 / EAI_RETURN_BW_PRIOR` = 65e9/31 = 2_096_774_193 ns. w_epoch hardcodes it at sender.rs:2910 as `Duration::from_nanos(2_097_000_000)`. They differ by 225_807 ns and drift independently: retiring the E-FULL debt (specs §16.1 `T_SPACING` row: `ölçülen return_bw gelince daralır`; §3.3-E FULL) by wiring a measured return_bw into EAI would silently leave the W_BTLBW window on the frozen 2.097 s literal. The 2_097_000_000 literal has no named constant (grep -n 'const .*2_097' sender.rs → none), which is a magic-constant violation of the project's own rule.
missed_mechanisms.suggested_classification: WIRE (single-source the prior behind one named constant before the E-FULL debt is retired) — not a v1 behaviour blocker, but a silent-divergence trap on the exact debt the spec says will be paid

corrected_classifications.reason: KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL is refuted by its own definitional requirement in this audit's rubric: 'must be default OFF'. The product default is ON — runtime.rs:195 sets initial_window_bytes = DEFAULT_BURST_CAP (2400), runtime.rs:854-858 pushes it into the engine unconditionally, and no product code path produces the OFF state. It is implemented, wired, default-enabled and exercised (client-core/tests/runtime_e2e.rs:762 asserts the shipped default is > 1200), which is SHIP. The genuine finding is orthogonal to the label and must be reported as such: the shipped default contradicts specs/adaptive-transport-engine-spec.md §3.3-A [K-D2] L302-303 ('PRE_CONVERGE'de burst tek-birime clamp'lenir'), specs contain no initial_window clause at all (grep across specs/*.md → zero hits), the engine's own doc says 'KALİBRE EDİLMEMİŞ: default flip ölçüm ister' (sender.rs:315), and the bench arm that generates campaign numbers defaults it to 0 while labelling 0 as 'sevk davranışı' (kama_product.rs:160) — so the product default is not the measured configuration. Per CLAUDE.md 'çelişkide spec kazanır' the resolution is a spec [AMENDMENT] or a default revert; mislabelling the mechanism as default-OFF obscures that a shipping default currently violates a frozen spec clause.

DELETE overstates the action the evidence supports. The dead-in-product fact is confirmed (grep: only tv_src.rs and tv_loss.rs call it; sender.rs:4024 uses effective_send_rate exclusively), but evaluate() is the executable target of the §16 TV-SRC / INV-RATE-1 conformance goldens, and spec L935 makes those goldens build-blocking ('sapma = build fail'). Deleting the function deletes the normative vector set. Under this rubric the honest label is KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL — intentionally outside the product path, verifiably not needed for any v1 product claim — with the real defect recorded separately: the INV-RATE-1 goldens are pinned on a function the product never executes, so drift between evaluate() (no fuzzy-gain leg, rate.rs:147-148) and effective_send_rate (fuzzy-gain leg, rate.rs:175) is undetectable. Remedy is re-pointing tv_src/tv_loss at effective_send_rate with gain‰=1000, after which DELETE becomes correct.

WIRE asserts 'v1 blocker', and that premise is not supported by any evidence in the finding or reproducible here. The absence is confirmed (grep: only the rtt.rs:6-7 deferral doc), but spec §6 L544 marks reordering_score itself '[CAL: EWMA α_reorder]' — an uncalibrated term — and the jitter axis it would enter affects ARQ reorder tolerance, which the product already adapts through a measured path (sender.rs:2989-2991 reorder.note_spurious → loss.set_packet_threshold at 3078-3079). The finding's own confidence is 'low' and its note says the necessity is doubtful. Absent a demonstrated v1 failure mode that only this term closes, the defensible label is KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL (spec-deferred, default absent, not load-bearing for any v1 claim). Promote to WIRE only if a v1 claim is shown to depend on it.

corrected_classifications.mechanism: estimator_confidence EWMA / ack_compression_score / external validity feed
corrected_classifications.reason: Label retained, but the justification must be narrowed to what is provable. Confirmed: the symbol set does not exist anywhere in crates (repo-wide grep), and the spec is normative in three places (§7.2 L575 bw_est = BtlBw × estimator_confidence_gate; §7.3 L580-597; TDD §5.1 L540 marked NORMATİF). Confirmed disconnected: bw.rs:221 update()'s only external validity input is `sample.delivered > 0` (sender.rs:2949/2971), so reverse_path_impaired and ack_delay_untrusted never invalidate a bandwidth sample — the code handles ack_delay untrust purely on the RTT side (sender.rs:3054-3057, raw sample still processed) and the bw sample survives. That is a real, spec-contradicting gap in the estimator that INV-CLASS-2 (TDD L731) depends on. What is NOT established is the 'v1 blocker' weight WIRE carries: §7.3 marks estimator_confidence '[CAL]'. Keep WIRE, but record required_for_v1 as OPEN rather than settled.
